name: nest-js-liveroom
description: **NestJS-Liveroom** is a real-time WebSocket application demonstrating a production-oriented approach to dynamic room management. It combines **NestJS, Socket.IO, and React** to create scalable live rooms where clients can dynamically join, communicate, and synchronize real-time state.

scripts.build: concurrently -p "[{name}]" -n "FRONTEND,BACKEND" "cd frontend && npm run build" "cd backend && npm run build"
scripts.dev: concurrently -p "[{name}]" -n "FRONTEND,BACKEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "cd frontend && npm run dev" "cd backend && npm run start:dev"
scripts.format: concurrently -p "[{name}]" -n "FRONTEND,BACKEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "cd frontend && npm run format" "cd backend && npm run format"

author: krupal-036
